faqs.q: What is the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel and where is it used?
faqs.a: The Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel is a pulley that changes the direction of a rope or multiplies a line pull. It is listed in sizes 15 mm to 100 mm, each size under its own Indus part number.

faqs.q: How do I read Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel part numbers such as IH-LR-BP-SEPSWSS-15MM?
faqs.a: IH-LR-BP-SEPSWSS-15MM is the 15 mm size, IH-LR-BP-SEPSWSS-32MM the 32 mm size and IH-LR-BP-SEPSWSS-100MM the 100 mm size. The size table lists every Indus part number with its own dimensions and rating, so quote the full part number rather than the series name.

faqs.q: What size range does the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel cover?
faqs.a: Sizes on the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel run 15 mm to 100 mm. The size table gives each one its own Indus part number and dimensions, and the [snatch blocks & pulleys shelf](/c/snatch-blocks-pulleys) lists the neighbouring products.

faqs.q: How should I pick the size of Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel for my job?
faqs.a: Size the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel from the load on the block, not the line pull: turned through 180° the rope loads the block with about twice the line pull. Then pick the row whose rope size fits your rope (4 mm, 5 mm, 6 mm and 8 mm and others).

faqs.q: What is the rated capacity of the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel?
faqs.a: No load rating is published on the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel listing, only dimensions, so we state none here. Send the load and application on the RFQ and we confirm a suitable rated option.

faqs.q: What material and finish does the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel have?
faqs.a: The Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel is made from type 304 or type 316 stainless steel and offered with these finishes: polished / electrophoretic coating. Stainless suits wet and corrosive sites.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel?
faqs.a: The listing for the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel names neither a standard nor a certificate. If your site needs a test certificate, say so on the RFQ and we confirm what the maker can supply before you order.

faqs.q: What do I use with the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel?
faqs.a: Rig the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel with [steel wire rope](/c/steel-wire-rope) of the matching size and connect its hook or eye to [shackles](/c/shackles) or [lifting hooks](/c/lifting-hooks). The [snatch blocks and pulleys shelf](/c/snatch-blocks-pulleys) lists the other blocks and pulleys.

faqs.q: How do I install and check the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel?
faqs.a: Before use, spin the Stainless Steel Swivel Eye Pulley Single Wheel sheave by hand, check the hook, eye and pin for wear or distortion, and rate the anchor point for the full load on the block. See [our snatch block versus pulley block guide](/blog/snatch-block-vs-pulley-block) for how block types differ.
